mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates signal accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and housing starts indicate broad economic contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO and HOUST declining does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), low federal funds rates signal monetary policy misalignment that fails to stimulate growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.25% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Strong nonfarm payrolls growth indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 150k (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 900,000 units signal a contracting housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) indicates monetary policy response to labor weakness that precedes equity market recovery, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS < 0.25% and UNRATE > 5.5% does not produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Supply chain disruptions indicated by industrial production declines exceeding 2.0% year-over-year increase input costs and reduce corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines > 2.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
